slides.texte_overlay:
Rare skills that draw
people towards you
Making people feel comfortable. Introducing the quiet person, offering a seat, a friendly joke. People want to be near someone who puts them at ease.
Telling a good story. A clear beginning, a funny middle, a short ending. Good storytellers always have an audience.
Staying positive without being fake. Seeing the good side of things, honestly. Real optimism is rare and attractive.
Giving thoughtful advice. Listening first, then sharing a calm, honest view. People seek out men who help them think clearly.
Before: I had little to add to conversations. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and people often ask me to tell them more.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had little to add to conversations. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. People often ask me to tell them more.

slides.texte_overlay: Knowing how to celebrate others. Raising a toast, sending a message, remembering a big day. Generosity draws people in.
Being reliable in small things. Showing up, replying, keeping promises. Trust is the base of every strong connection.
